verdict: FAIL on evidence discipline only — every load-bearing holiday fact now reproduces. All ten round-1 discrepancies are addressed (D1, D3, D4, D6, D7, D9, D10 fully and independently confirmed; D2 and D5 in substance; D8 partially). No date, status, tier or instant VALUE is wrong anywhere in the 440 family rows, and none is inferred from another year. Four issues remain, one of them introduced by the fix round: the corrected 'Failed retrievals' text makes a false claim about what the archive holds (N1); the D5 class of paraphrased instants was fixed only for the enumerated fields and survives elsewhere, including one field with the identical defect the fixer said it had swept up (N2); D8's supplementary manifest still leaves 67 files unhashed while its preamble implies otherwise (N3); and 314 `verbatim`/instant fields are hard-truncated mid-token at a fixed character budget, contrary to the file's own stated notation, which in two places loses part of an instant CME actually printed (N4).
